text:
jay: FYI SLI sampler flagged a p50 token-latency jump (~+30%) for model:v2 on /chat route in eu-west after kernel patch last night.

maria: link to dashboard? numbers and time window?

jay: https://dash.re/redwood/perf/1758 -> p50 token latency 42ms -> 55ms (peak), p95 also up. window 23:10-23:40 UTC

alex: ran the sampler query, attaching snippet:
```
SELECT route, model_version, bucket, p50_token_ms, p95_token_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate
FROM token_latency_samples
WHERE time BETWEEN '2026-03-16T23:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-16T23:45:00Z'
AND region='eu-west';
```

alex: results show model:v2 p50=55ms, kv_cache_hit_rate dropped 18% on same hosts

dmitri: that matches change in batching heuristics rollout (switch to adaptive windowing). I suspect kernel selection fallback is hitting slower kernel for short tokens.

dmitri: quick check: kernel chosen when seq_len<64 -> kernelA else kernelB. Recent autotuner misclassified many seq=32 requests.

jay: can we add per-route kernel selector breakdown to the model-compare dashboard? need to correlate kernel -> token-level SLI.

maria: +1. Also add KV cache hit-rate and batching window distribution. If kv hit drops, token lat rises.

perf-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://dash.re/redwood/snapshots/1758456790. Added tags: per-route, model:v2, eu-west

alex: proposed quick mitigation: force kernelA for v2 in eu-west for canary traffic and revert adaptive batching for 30m. Who wants to trigger?

dmitri: I'll flip kernel flag for canary and roll back batching change in canary env. Monitoring p50 and kv_hit.

maria: awesome. If p50 recovers <+10% we can promote fix to rollout. log any regressions here :eyes:
